pages.title: Moto Race City
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Moto Race City rewards you for staying on the road and extending your motorcycle ride. Overtake traffic without crashing to earn money for more bikes. Different models have their own speed, handling, and braking characteristics for the roads ahead.

pages.title: Travel Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Travel Mahjong Deluxe uses travel-themed tiles in a board-clearing puzzle. Find identical pairs with at least one side free and remove them from the layout. Think about which matches will uncover more choices as the arrangements become more difficult.

pages.title: Obby Highest Jump Ever
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Obby Highest Jump Ever combines clicking for strength with a climbing challenge. Increase your jump power, reach higher rooftops, and collect trophies for new milestones. Keep developing the character as the route progresses from small buildings to much taller towers.

pages.title: Hidden Object: Emily's Case
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hidden Object: Emily's Case follows an investigation into a girl's disappearance in Victorian London. Search detailed scenes for listed objects and clues, then solve puzzles and mini-games. Zoom into the surroundings when a small detail is hard to find.

pages.title: Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2 sends a stickman into a block-built world filled with infected enemies. Run, jump, collect coins, and shoot zombies while searching for Eve. Find stronger weapons and use a jetpack for higher jumps when one becomes available.

pages.title: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Sniper Wars: Find the Criminal asks you to identify a suspect among a crowd. Compare the people with the supplied photograph, switch to the rifle scope, and take the shot when you find the match. Careful observation precedes each attack.

pages.title: Bus Parking Out
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Bus Parking Out is a parking-lot puzzle with buses of different sizes, colors, and movement directions. Rearrange them to clear an exit for the selected bus. Free the right vehicles so they can collect passengers of matching colors.

pages.title: BouncePop Quest
pages.creator: Nikfort Games
pages.description: BouncePop Quest follows Jumpo, a color-changing jelly creature, through platform challenges. Hold to charge a jump and release to launch toward stars and new platforms. Judge the power carefully to avoid enemies, moving obstacles, and environmental hazards.

pages.title: Wood & Screw Puzzle
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Wood & Screw Puzzle asks you to untangle wooden arrangements held together by fasteners. Work out which bolts or nuts to remove and how the stack will change afterward. Choose the sequence carefully to resolve the current puzzle.

pages.title: Domino Solitaire
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Domino Solitaire turns domino matching into a solo puzzle. Drag pieces from the lower area to connect with the ones above, using matching values. Plan the order of placements so you can keep finding useful connections.

pages.title: Type Sprint
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Type Sprint makes typing the engine of a running race. Enter the displayed letters quickly to build platforms for your stickman and move ahead of the competition. Keep your typing accurate while trying to finish among the first three racers.

pages.title: Offroad Muddy Trucks
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Offroad Muddy Trucks lets you drive large trucks over uneven, muddy terrain. Take on a career alone or with a second player, or explore the free-driving map together. Use the vehicles' power and nitro to handle difficult ground.

pages.title: Fashion Dye Pro
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Fashion Dye Pro lets you customize clothing and beach accessories with tie-dye patterns. Tie a garment, apply colors, and develop a design for a customer's request. Experiment with different shades and placements to create another finished outfit.

pages.title: Merge Food Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Merge Food Puzzle turns matching food into new, higher-level items instead of simply removing it. Combine compatible pieces to expand the available foods. Choose between the barbecue and fruit modes and work toward discovering further combinations.

pages.title: Machine City Balls
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Machine City Balls puts a rolling ball through a mechanical parkour course. Slide to guide it along the route and complete the ball-control challenges. Collect rare balls as you progress and try to keep each run on course.

pages.title: Tile Connect Club
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tile Connect Club is a timed picture-matching puzzle. Find two identical tiles that can be connected and remove the pair from the board. Work through the animals, flowers, fruit, and other pictures before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Boxing Gang Stars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Boxing Gang Stars brings physics-driven boxers into the ring for solo or two-player fights. Move into range, throw different punches, and block the opponent's blows. Keeping your fighter positioned well helps turn the exchanges in your favor.

pages.title: Grand Cyber City
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Grand Cyber City offers a collection of vehicle simulations across missions, races, challenges, and free play. Drive cars or try other transport such as bikes and motorbikes. Explore the different activities and use the vehicle controls suited to each one.

pages.title: Blondie in the Real World
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Blondie in the Real World follows a doll-world character trying everyday activities outside her perfect surroundings. Help with makeup, room cleaning, and baking a cake for visitors. Work through the tasks as she puts together her new experience.

pages.title: Zombie Parade Defense 6
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Zombie Parade Defense 6 sends you through ten stages of zombie attacks. Fight the incoming enemies and visit the market to strengthen your weapons or increase health. Later stages bring stronger opposition, making the upgrades increasingly useful.

pages.title: Ultimate maze! Collect them all!
pages.creator: Neman Group
pages.description: Ultimate Maze! Collect Them All! takes you through mazes with puzzles, traps, and characters to unlock. Choose a movement direction by swiping or using the arrows. Follow the current level's displayed objective while working around its obstacles.

pages.title: Jetpack Kiwi Lite
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Jetpack Kiwi Lite is a side-scrolling shooter with enemy spacecraft and a boss battle. Choose a character with its own special attack, then move, shoot, and use bombs through four levels. Play alone or with a friend in local co-op.

pages.title: Mad Cat
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Mad Cat puts a destructive kitten in an apartment full of breakable objects. Knock items off the level or destroy them while avoiding the owner and her mop. Pick up food for temporary extra speed as you continue the rampage.

pages.title: Push Puzzle Rescue Adventure
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Push Puzzle Rescue Adventure follows Sara as she rebuilds an animal rescue center. Push rocks and garbage cans out of the way to reach stranded creatures. Find keys, open doors, and avoid ground vines while solving each route puzzle.

pages.title: Happy Cat Puzzle
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Happy Cat Puzzle makes your drawn lines guide water balls into a glass. Sketch a route that carries enough of them to the target without losing the flow. Experiment with different solutions and try to finish with three stars.

pages.title: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Car Eats Car: Arctic Adventure combines driving, hostile rivals, and car-rescue missions. Accelerate over rough routes, balance the vehicle, and use bombs or turbo to get past trouble. Keep moving through the opposition while working to free captured cars.

pages.title: Bloo Kid
pages.creator: winterworks GmbH
pages.description: Bloo Kid is a retro platform game about rescuing a girlfriend from an evil wizard. Run and jump around single-screen levels, landing on enemies to defeat them. Holding the jump button gives extra height across the game's eight worlds.

pages.title: Spooky Run
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Spooky Run sends you along a Halloween route collecting sweets. Move left or right to gather candy and avoid hazards that end the run. Save enough sweets to unlock a special character and try to beat your best score.

pages.title: Toon Blast Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Toon Blast Online asks you to choose blocks that help a small bear escape dangerous traps. Inspect the setup before tapping so the move clears a safe route. Fire, spikes, water, and other hazards make the right selection essential.

pages.title: Get the Stars - Extended
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Get the Stars - Extended is a movement puzzle about collecting stars and opening the next route. Navigate the current area, gather every required star, and obtain the key. Complete the objectives to advance through one hundred levels.

pages.title: Enchantment
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Enchantment lets you prepare Mira's appearance with face care, hair, and clothing choices. Adjust her complexion and eyebrows, choose a hairstyle and accessories, then pick a traditional or modern outfit. Combine the steps into her finished makeover.

pages.title: Mouth Shift 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Mouth Shift 3D challenges you to change a character's mouth shape while moving along a food-filled course. Slide to reshape it and collect suitable food. Watch the road obstacles at the same time to keep the run going.

pages.title: 2048 X2 Merge Blocks
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: 2048 X2 Merge Blocks combines falling-number placement with merging. Choose a column for the next block and connect identical values to produce larger numbers. Keep making room in the field as more blocks arrive from above.

pages.title: Merge Push
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Merge Push asks you to place numbered blocks into columns and bring matching values together. Each merge creates a larger number and helps control the descending stack. Plan placements before the incoming blocks reach the bottom.

pages.title: BFFS Night Out
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: BFFs Night Out lets you prepare princesses for an evening together. Apply makeup and choose outfits for each friend, combining the available pieces into party-ready looks. Try different styles before settling on their plans for the night.

pages.title: Personal Computer
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Personal Computer turns freelance computer jobs into a series of interactive tasks. Use the mouse and keyboard to complete the customer's instructions and receive payment. Work through further levels as you develop the computer-work routine.

pages.title: City Truck Driver
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: City Truck Driver offers truck missions, races, and free driving in a large city. Choose among thirteen truck models, customize a vehicle, and connect or detach its trailer when needed. Solo and two-player options provide different ways to drive.

pages.title: Helicopter Rescue Flying Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Helicopter Rescue Flying Simulator 3D lets you complete flying missions around a city. Control the helicopter's movement, takeoff, and landing while working through the assignments. Collect cash and finish missions to unlock additional helicopters.

pages.title: Soft Girl Aesthetic
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Soft Girl Aesthetic lets you style Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet with a new fashion theme. Choose appearance and outfit options for each school friend. Combine the available pieces to create their versions of a soft-girl look.

pages.title: Knock Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Knock Rush is a shooting game about knocking enemies down with unusual weapons. Tap to fire at the opponents ahead and work through the encounters. A weapon-customization option lets you put together equipment of your own.

pages.title: Wheel Duel
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Wheel Duel makes changing wheel size part of a stunt race. Slide to enlarge or shrink the car's wheels as terrain and obstacles change. Pick a size that helps the vehicle pass the current section and continue toward the finish.

pages.title: Ace Moto Rider
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Ace Moto Rider puts you in a first-person motorcycle run through highway traffic. Steer between vehicles and reach the end of each level without crashing. Nitro gives extra speed, but leaves less time to react to nearby traffic.

pages.title: Limo Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Limo Jigsaw turns limousine pictures into puzzles made from scattered pieces. Select an image and drag its sections into their correct positions. Match the vehicle's details and the surrounding scene until the complete picture is restored.

pages.title: Circus Dart Wheel
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Circus Dart Wheel challenges you to throw darts at targets near a person on a rotating wheel. Aim carefully to score without hitting the performer. Shots closer to a target's center earn more points, making timing and precision essential.

pages.title: Super Wash 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Super Wash 2 gives you dirty objects to clean with a pressure washer. Direct the spray over muddy surfaces and keep working until the object is clean. Complete the washing tasks across thirty levels of different items.

pages.title: Connect The Jelly
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Connect The Jelly is a path-drawing puzzle about joining matching jelly pairs. Tap a jelly and drag a connection toward its partner. Plan the routes carefully so that each pair can be connected within the board.

pages.title: Happy Birthday Cake Decor
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Happy Birthday Cake Decor lets you design a cake for a birthday celebration. Choose decorative options and combine them into the look you want. Try different arrangements to turn the plain dessert into a finished party centerpiece.

pages.title: Escape from the Mountain Village
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Escape from the Mountain Village is a point-and-click escape puzzle. Explore the village scenes, collect items, and use clues to solve locks and other puzzles. Check the inventory when an object might help open the next part of your route.

pages.title: Flying Easter Bunny
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flying Easter Bunny challenges you to collect eggs during an airborne Easter run. Control the bunny with mouse or touch input and gather as many as possible. Some eggs add time, helping you extend the attempt and improve the total.

pages.title: Funny Parking
pages.creator: kalem
pages.description: Funny Parking turns parking into an aiming challenge with physics-driven cars. Choose a vehicle, line up its direction, and launch it toward the marked parking area. Garage upgrades let you improve characteristics such as impact force, armor, and fuel.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Mischief Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Mischief Time follows Hazel and Mia while they play during her mother's absence. Help the friends enjoy their activities, then put things back when Mom may return. Watch the situation so the room is ready before they are caught.

pages.title: Armour Crush
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Armour Crush is a tank-deployment strategy game about destroying an opposing base. Drag cards to send units into battle and assemble at least three tanks to advance. Choose the types and timing of your deployments to overpower the defense.

pages.title: Cute Kitty Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Cute Kitty Jigsaw offers twelve cat pictures to assemble, unlocking them in sequence. Drag the pieces into place to rebuild each image. Three difficulty modes let you choose a smaller puzzle or take on more pieces.

pages.title: Ellie Back Treatment
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ellie Back Treatment lets you carry out a fictional spa session for Ellie. Apply the available tools to work on the rashes and bumps on her back. Finish the salon routine with hot stones and a massage.

pages.title: Rush Road Hour
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Rush Road Hour puts your car into busy traffic for a driving survival challenge. Move between lanes to avoid other vehicles and obstacles ahead. Keep reacting to the road to extend the run and improve your score.

pages.title: Jungle Dino Hunter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Jungle Dino Hunter sends you into environments occupied by alert dinosaurs. Take aim with a rifle, reload when needed, and choose between sniper and assault-style play. After a shot, the creatures begin searching for the source of the attack.

pages.title: Volleyball 2020
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Volleyball 2020 is a short volleyball match played by heading the ball. Move into position and jump to send it back over the court. Score as many points as you can before the ninety-second match ends.

pages.title: Russia Extreeme Grand Snow Clean Road Simulator 19
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Russia Extreeme Grand Snow Clean Road Simulator 19 puts a heavy snow-clearing vehicle on blocked roads. Drive the loader through the route and clear snow from the city. Watch the ice and other obstructions while maneuvering the large machine.

pages.title: Perfect Halloween Pumpkin
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Perfect Halloween Pumpkin lets you give a pumpkin its own Halloween style. Choose from the available dress-up and decorative options, then combine them into a finished character. Experiment with different looks for the seasonal design.

pages.title: Mission Escape Rooms
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Mission Escape Rooms is an exploration puzzle about finding a way out. Look around the rooms, inspect the surroundings, and interact with objects to work through the riddles. Move through the area while searching for the clues needed to escape.

pages.title: Horse Jumping Show 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Horse Jumping Show 3D asks you to ride a horse along a marked course. Choose a suitable speed and time jumps to clear the obstacles. Keep the horse aligned with the track while preparing for the next fence.

pages.title: Milk The Cow
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Milk The Cow is a speed challenge about filling four buckets with milk. Use the indicated keyboard or touch controls to work as quickly as possible. Complete the milking task and compare how long the attempt took.

pages.title: Bffs Velvet Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bffs Velvet Party lets you prepare Belle and Moana for a party at a hotel. Choose dark-toned makeup, then pick velvet-inspired clothing and coordinating accessories. Style both friends before they head to the event.

pages.title: Jolly Volley
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Jolly Volley is a volleyball duel played by colorful blobs. Move into position to return the ball over the net and keep it from landing on your side. Send it past the opposing blob to build your score.

pages.title: EG Link Dots
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Link Dots asks you to connect dots of the same color. Hold and drag from one dot toward its matching partner to draw a path. Plan the connections across the board until all the colored pairs are joined.

pages.title: Crazy Alien Dog
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crazy Alien Dog is an endless runner with jungle and farm worlds to explore. Keep the dog moving through the route and extend the run as far as possible. Visit the shop to buy items or new clothing.

pages.title: Cannon Hero Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cannon Hero Online challenges you to aim a cannon at enemies. Line up each shot and fire when you have a useful angle. Successful hits earn points and rewards as the hero continues fighting through the opposition.

pages.title: Pony Ice Cream Cone
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Pony Ice Cream Cone guides you through making a pony-themed ice cream dessert. Prepare the cone, add colorful ice cream, and finish with decorations. Combine the choices into a sweet creation with your own preferred appearance.

pages.title: Little Dino Adventure
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Little Dino Adventure is a platform journey about collecting eggs. Guide the dinosaur through three stages, jump into yellow blocks for extra eggs, and look for the large golden ones. Try to finish each stage with all three golden eggs.

pages.title: Temple Crossing
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Temple Crossing asks you to build bridges for an explorer moving between temple platforms. Time the bridge's length so it reaches the other side safely. Earn coins and buy helpful power-ups as you try to cross more gaps.

pages.title: Princesses at World Championship 2018
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses at World Championship 2018 lets you prepare two princesses for a football championship match. Choose looks for the event and coordinate their appearances. Work through the available styling options before they join the evening's celebration.

pages.title: Diamond Hunter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Diamond Hunter is a survival challenge about gathering diamonds while dodging falling hazards. Avoid rocks and bombs, collect the gems, and throw them into the cart for points. Keep the attempt going to improve your score.

pages.title: Solitaire HD
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Solitaire HD challenges you to organize a card layout and build the foundation piles. Alternate red and black cards in the columns and move suitable cards to their ordered foundations. Finish efficiently to improve your time and score.

pages.title: Wasteland Warriors
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Wasteland Warriors is a multiplayer shooter set in a post-apocalyptic arena. Move through the battlefield, engage rival players, and try to climb the leaderboard. The free-for-all format makes every other warrior a potential opponent.

pages.title: Frizzle Fraz 6
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Frizzle Fraz 6 sends a fuzzy hero into an underwater world to find missing friends. Move through the undersea surroundings and explore the route ahead. Keep searching the levels to reunite the character with the lost companions.

pages.title: Valentines Day Cinema
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Valentines Day Cinema helps Rachel get ready for a romantic trip to the movies. Find the belongings she needs before she runs out of time, then choose suitable clothing. Complete the preparations so she can make the date.
